title: 2022 UCC hybrid-transaction amendments
summary: The book reproduces proposed scope text and describes enactment as at an early stage in April 2023.
notes: The reproduced definition includes a sale of goods combined with services, a lease of other goods, or a sale, lease, or license of other property. If goods aspects do not predominate, provisions primarily relating to those aspects apply; provisions primarily relating to the whole transaction do not. If goods aspects predominate, Article 2 applies without necessarily excluding other law for nongoods aspects. No present state adoption is inferred.
